verdict.rationale: Retell docs explicitly describe custom function calling to call external APIs mid-call (retell-docs-5, retell-docs-35, retell-docs-66) with configurable URL/method/headers/parameters, plus MCP tool-calling during live calls (retell-docs-6/23/36). Latency-aware transcription modes (retell-docs-9/39/48) and general voice quality feedback (retell-comm-6/7/8) suggest the platform is designed to keep conversation natural, though no direct evidence specifically addresses filler/hold speech during function execution latency. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of 'speak while waiting' or filler-phrase mechanics during API calls, and independent benchmarks confirming no dead air.
